verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ὁ Ἰησοῦς περιεπάτει ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ γὰρ οὐ ἤθελεν περιπατεῖν ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ ὅτι οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: Kai meta tauta ho Iēsous periepatei en tē Galilaia gar ou ēthelen peripatein en tē Ioudaia hoti hoi Ioudaioi ezētoun apokteinai auton
verses.literal: - After this - Jesus traveled throughout - Galilee - vvv He did not want to travel in - Judea because the Jews [there] were trying to kill Him

verses.original: δὲ ἡ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἑορτὴ ἡ σκηνοπηγία ἦν ἐγγὺς
verses.transliteration: de hē tōn Ioudaiōn heortē hē skēnopēgia ēn engys
verses.literal: However the vvv Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near

verses.original: οὖν αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτὸν Μετάβηθι ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ὕπαγε εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν ἵνα σου οἱ μαθηταί καὶ θεωρήσουσιν σοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ποιεῖς
verses.transliteration: oun autou hoi adelphoi eipon pros auton Metabēthi enteuthen kai hypage eis tēn Ioudaian hina sou hoi mathētai kai theōrēsousin sou ta erga ha poieis
verses.literal: So [Jesus’] - brothers said to Him Leave here and go to - Judea so that Your - disciples [there] may see [the] - works - You are doing

verses.original: γάρ οὐδεὶς αὐτὸς ζητεῖ εἶναι ἐν παρρησίᾳ ποιεῖ τι ἐν κρυπτῷ καὶ εἰ ποιεῖς ταῦτα φανέρωσον σεαυτὸν τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: gar oudeis autos zētei einai en parrēsia poiei ti en kryptō kai ei poieis tauta phanerōson seauton tō kosmō
verses.literal: For no one [who] wants to be [known] vvv publicly acts . . . in secret - Since You are doing these things show Yourself to the world

verses.original: γὰρ οὐδὲ αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: gar oude autou hoi adelphoi episteuon eis auton
verses.literal: For [even] His [own] brothers did {not} believe in Him

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτοῖς δὲ ὁ ὑμέτερος ὁ καιρὸς ἐστιν πάντοτέ ἕτοιμος ὁ ἐμὸς Ὁ καιρὸς οὔπω πάρεστιν
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous Legei autois de ho hymeteros ho kairos estin pantote hetoimos ho emos Ho kairos oupō parestin
verses.literal: Therefore - Jesus told them Although - your - time is always at hand - My - time {has} not yet come

verses.original: ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται μισεῖν ὑμᾶς δὲ μισεῖ ἐμὲ ὅτι ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ἐστιν πονηρά
verses.transliteration: ho kosmos ou dynatai misein hymas de misei eme hoti egō martyrō peri autou hoti autou ta erga estin ponēra
verses.literal: The world vvv cannot hate you but it hates Me because I testify . . . . . . that its - works are evil

verses.original: ἀνάβητε εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν ὑμεῖς ἐγὼ οὐκ ἀναβαίνω εἰς ταύτην τὴν ἑορτὴν ὅτι ἐμὸς ὁ καιρὸς οὔπω πεπλήρωται
verses.transliteration: anabēte eis tēn heortēn hymeis egō ouk anabainō eis tautēn tēn heortēn hoti emos ho kairos oupō peplērōtai
verses.literal: Go up to the feast on your own I {am} not going up to this - feast because My - time {has} not yet come

verses.original: δὲ εἰπὼν Ταῦτα αὐτὸς ἔμεινεν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de eipōn Tauta autos emeinen en tē Galilaia
verses.literal: - Having said [this] - [Jesus] remained in - Galilee

verses.original: δὲ Ὡς αὐτοῦ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἀνέβησαν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν τότε αὐτὸς καὶ ἀνέβη οὐ φανερῶς ἀλλὰ ὡς ἐν κρυπτῷ
verses.transliteration: de Hōs autou hoi adelphoi anebēsan eis tēn heortēn tote autos kai anebē ou phanerōs alla hōs en kryptō
verses.literal: But [after] His - brothers had gone up to the feast - He also went not publicly but - in secret

verses.original: οὖν Οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ καὶ ἔλεγον Ποῦ ἐστιν ἐκεῖνος
verses.transliteration: oun Hoi Ioudaioi ezētoun auton en tē heortē kai elegon Pou estin ekeinos
verses.literal: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking Where is He

verses.original: καὶ πολὺς ἐν τοῖς ὄχλοις ἦν γογγυσμὸς περὶ αὐτοῦ μὲν οἱ ἔλεγον ὅτι ἐστιν Ἀγαθός δὲ Ἄλλοι ἔλεγον Οὔ ἀλλὰ πλανᾷ τὸν ὄχλον
verses.transliteration: kai polys en tois ochlois ēn gongysmos peri autou men hoi elegon hoti estin Agathos de Alloi elegon Ou alla plana ton ochlon
verses.literal: - Many in the crowds were whispering about Him - Some said - He is a good [man] But others replied No . . . He deceives the people

verses.original: μέντοι Οὐδεὶς ἐλάλει παρρησίᾳ περὶ αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν φόβον τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: mentoi Oudeis elalei parrēsia peri autou dia ton phobon tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: Yet no one would speak publicly about Him for - fear of the Jews

verses.original: δὲ Ἤδη μεσούσης τῆς ἑορτῆς Ἰησοῦς ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν καὶ ἐδίδασκεν
verses.transliteration: de Ēdē mesousēs tēs heortēs Iēsous anebē eis to hieron kai edidasken
verses.literal: vvv vvv About halfway through the feast Jesus went up to the temple [courts] and began to teach

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐθαύμαζον λέγοντες Πῶς οὗτος οἶδεν γράμματα μὴ μεμαθηκώς
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi ethaumazon legontes Pōs houtos oiden grammata mē memathēkōs
verses.literal: - The Jews were amazed [and] asked How {did} this [man] attain [such] learning without having studied

verses.original: Ἐμὴ Ἡ διδαχὴ ἔστιν οὐκ ἐμὴ οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπεν ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με
verses.transliteration: Emē HĒ didachē estin ouk emē oun ho Iēsous Apekrithē autois kai eipen alla tou pempsantos me
verses.literal: My - teaching is not My own - - Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . [It comes] from Him who sent Me

verses.original: ἐάν τις θέλῃ ποιεῖν αὐτοῦ τὸ θέλημα γνώσεται περὶ πότερον τῆς διδαχῆς ἐστιν ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἢ ἐγὼ λαλῶ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ean tis thelē poiein autou to thelēma gnōsetai peri poteron tēs didachēs estin ek tou Theou ē egō lalō ap’ emautou
verses.literal: If anyone desires to do His - will he will know . . . whether [My] teaching is from - God or [whether] I speak on My own

verses.original: ὁ λαλῶν ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ζητεῖ τὴν ἰδίαν τὴν δόξαν δὲ ὁ ζητῶν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτὸν οὗτος ἐστιν ἀληθής καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἔστιν οὐκ ἀδικία
verses.transliteration: ho lalōn aph’ heautou zētei tēn idian tēn doxan de ho zētōn tēn doxan tou pempsantos auton houtos estin alēthēs kai en autō estin ouk adikia
verses.literal: He who speaks on his own [authority] seeks [his] own - glory but He who seeks the glory of the [One who] sent Him - is a man of truth - in Him there is no falsehood

verses.original: Οὐ Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὸν νόμον καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ποιεῖ τὸν νόμον τί ζητεῖτε ἀποκτεῖναι με
verses.transliteration: Ou Mōusēs dedōken hymin ton nomon kai oudeis ex hymōn poiei ton nomon ti zēteite apokteinai me
verses.literal: {Has} not Moses given you the law Yet not one of you keeps vvv [it] Why are you trying to kill Me

verses.original: ἔχεις Δαιμόνιον ὁ ὄχλος Ἀπεκρίθη τίς ζητεῖ ἀποκτεῖναι σε
verses.transliteration: echeis Daimonion ho ochlos Apekrithē tis zētei apokteinai se
verses.literal: You have a demon the crowd replied Who is trying to kill You

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἐποίησα Ἓν ἔργον καὶ πάντες θαυμάζετε
verses.transliteration: Iēsous Apekrithē kai eipen autois epoiēsa Hen ergon kai pantes thaumazete
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . . . . them I did one miracle and vvv you are all amazed

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο Μωϋσῆς δέδωκεν ὑμῖν τὴν περιτομήν καὶ περιτέμνετε ἄνθρωπον ἐν σαββάτῳ οὐχ ὅτι ἐστὶν ἐκ τοῦ Μωϋσέως ἀλλ’ ἐκ τῶν πατέρων
verses.transliteration: dia touto Mōusēs dedōken hymin tēn peritomēn kai peritemnete anthrōpon en sabbatō ouch hoti estin ek tou Mōuseōs all’ ek tōn paterōn
verses.literal: [But] because . . . Moses gave you - circumcision - you circumcise a boy on [the] Sabbath (not that it is from - Moses but from the patriarchs

verses.original: εἰ ἄνθρωπος λαμβάνει περιτομὴν ἐν σαββάτῳ ἵνα ὁ νόμος Μωϋσέως μὴ λυθῇ χολᾶτε ἐμοὶ ὅτι ἐποίησα ὅλον ἄνθρωπον ὑγιῆ ἐν σαββάτῳ
verses.transliteration: ei anthrōpos lambanei peritomēn en sabbatō hina ho nomos Mōuseōs mē lythē cholate emoi hoti epoiēsa holon anthrōpon hygiē en sabbatō
verses.literal: If a boy vvv can be circumcised on [the] Sabbath so that the law of Moses {will} not be broken [why] are you angry with Me for making [the] whole man well on the Sabbath

verses.original: μὴ κρίνετε κατ’ ὄψιν ἀλλὰ κρίνετε τὴν δικαίαν κρίσιν
verses.transliteration: mē krinete kat’ opsin alla krinete tēn dikaian krisin
verses.literal: Stop judging by outward appearances [and start] judging - justly . . .

verses.original: οὖν τινες ἐκ τῶν Ἱεροσολυμιτῶν Ἔλεγον ἐστιν Οὐχ οὗτός ὃν ζητοῦσιν ἀποκτεῖναι
verses.transliteration: oun tines ek tōn Hierosolymitōn Elegon estin Ouch houtos hon zētousin apokteinai
verses.literal: Then some of the [people] of Jerusalem began to say Isn’t . . . this [the man] they are trying to kill

verses.original: καὶ ἴδε λαλεῖ παρρησίᾳ καὶ λέγουσιν Μή‿ οὐδὲν αὐτῷ ποτε οἱ ἄρχοντες ἀληθῶς ἔγνωσαν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: kai ide lalei parrēsia kai legousin Mē ouden autō pote hoi archontes alēthōs egnōsan hoti houtos estin ho Christos
verses.literal: Yet here He is, speaking publicly and they are not saying . . . [anything] to Him - {Have} the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ

verses.original: ἀλλὰ οἴδαμεν πόθεν τοῦτον ἐστίν δὲ ὅταν ὁ Χριστὸς ἔρχηται οὐδεὶς γινώσκει πόθεν ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: alla oidamen pothen touton estin de hotan ho Christos erchētai oudeis ginōskei pothen estin
verses.literal: But we know where this [man] is {from} - When the Christ comes no one will know where He is {from}

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ Ἔκραξεν καὶ λέγων οἴδατε Κἀμὲ καὶ οἴδατε πόθεν εἰμί καὶ οὐκ ἐλήλυθα ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ ἀλλ’ ὁ πέμψας με ἔστιν ἀληθινὸς ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε ὃν
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous didaskōn en tō hierō Ekraxen kai legōn oidate Kame kai oidate pothen eimi kai ouk elēlytha ap’ emautou all’ ho pempsas me estin alēthinos hymeis ouk oidate hon
verses.literal: Then - Jesus still teaching in the temple [courts] cried out . . . . . . You know Me and you know where I am {from} - vvv I have not come of My own accord but He who sent Me is true You {do} not know Him

verses.original: ἐγὼ οἶδα αὐτόν ὅτι εἰμι παρ’ αὐτοῦ κἀκεῖνός ἀπέστειλεν με
verses.transliteration: egō oida auton hoti eimi par’ autou kakeinos apesteilen me
verses.literal: but I know Him because I am from Him and He sent Me

verses.original: οὖν Ἐζήτουν πιάσαι αὐτὸν καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν τὴν χεῖρα ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ὅτι αὐτοῦ ἡ ὥρα οὔπω ἐληλύθει
verses.transliteration: oun Ezētoun piasai auton kai oudeis epebalen tēn cheira ep’ auton hoti autou hē hōra oupō elēlythei
verses.literal: So they tried to seize Him but no one laid - a hand on Him because His - hour {had} not yet come

verses.original: πολλοὶ Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου δὲ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν καὶ ἔλεγον ὅταν Ὁ Χριστὸς ἔλθῃ μὴ ποιήσει πλείονα σημεῖα ὧν οὗτος ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: polloi Ek tou ochlou de episteusan eis auton kai elegon hotan Ho Christos elthē mē poiēsei pleiona sēmeia hōn houtos epoiēsen
verses.literal: Many in the crowd however believed in Him and said When the Christ comes vvv will He perform more signs than this [man] -

verses.original: οἱ Φαρισαῖοι Ἤκουσαν τοῦ ὄχλου γογγύζοντος ταῦτα περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἀπέστειλαν ὑπηρέτας ἵνα πιάσωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: hoi Pharisaioi Ēkousan tou ochlou gongyzontos tauta peri autou kai hoi Pharisaioi kai hoi archiereis apesteilan hypēretas hina piasōsin auton
verses.literal: [When] the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about [Jesus] - - [they] and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν εἰμι μεθ’ ὑμῶν Ἔτι μικρὸν χρόνον καὶ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous eipen eimi meth’ hymōn Eti mikron chronon kai hypagō pros ton pempsanta me
verses.literal: So - Jesus said I am with you only a little while longer and then I am going to the [One who] sent Me

verses.original: ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετέ με καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ εἰμὶ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: zētēsete me kai ouch heurēsete me kai hopou egō eimi hymeis ou dynasthe elthein
verses.literal: You will look for Me [but] vvv you will not find Me and where I am you vvv cannot come

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Εἶπον πρὸς ἑαυτούς Ποῦ οὗτος μέλλει πορεύεσθαι ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὐχ εὑρήσομεν αὐτόν μὴ μέλλει πορεύεσθαι εἰς τὴν Διασπορὰν τῶν Ἑλλήνων καὶ διδάσκειν τοὺς Ἕλληνας
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi Eipon pros heautous Pou houtos mellei poreuesthai hoti hēmeis ouch heurēsomen auton mē mellei poreuesthai eis tēn Diasporan tōn Hellēnōn kai didaskein tous Hellēnas
verses.literal: At this the Jews said to one another Where {does} He intend to go that we vvv will not find Him vvv Will He go where the [Jews] are dispersed among the Greeks and teach the Greeks

verses.original: τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ λόγος ὃν εἶπεν Ζητήσετέ με καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσετέ με καὶ Ὅπου ἐγὼ εἰμὶ ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν
verses.transliteration: tis estin houtos ho logos hon eipen Zētēsete me kai ouch heurēsete me kai Hopou egō eimi hymeis ou dynasthe elthein
verses.literal: What vvv vvv vvv does He mean by saying You will look for Me [but] vvv you will not find Me and Where I am you vvv cannot come

verses.original: δὲ Ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ τῇ μεγάλῃ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἑορτῆς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἱστήκει καὶ ἔκραξεν λέγων Ἐάν τις διψᾷ ἐρχέσθω πρός με καὶ πινέτω
verses.transliteration: de En tē eschatē tē megalē hēmera tēs heortēs ho Iēsous heistēkei kai ekraxen legōn Ean tis dipsa erchesthō pros me kai pinetō
verses.literal: - On the last [and] greatest day of the feast - Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice . . . If anyone is thirsty let him come to Me and drink

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμέ καθὼς ἡ γραφή εἶπεν Ποταμοὶ ζῶντος ὕδατος ῥεύσουσιν ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho pisteuōn eis eme kathōs hē graphē eipen Potamoi zōntos hydatos rheusousin ek tēs koilias autou
verses.literal: Whoever believes in Me as the Scripture has said Streams of living water will flow from - [within] him

verses.original: δὲ τοῦτο εἶπεν περὶ τοῦ Πνεύματος οὗ οἱ πιστεύσαντες εἰς αὐτόν ἔμελλον λαμβάνειν γὰρ Πνεῦμα ἦν οὔπω ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐδέπω ἐδοξάσθη
verses.transliteration: de touto eipen peri tou Pneumatos hou hoi pisteusantes eis auton emellon lambanein gar Pneuma ēn oupō hoti Iēsous oudepō edoxasthē
verses.literal: - vvv He was speaking about the Spirit whom those who believed in Him were later to receive For [the] Spirit had not yet [been given] because Jesus {had} not yet been glorified

verses.original: οὖν ἀκούσαντες τούτων τῶν λόγων Ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου ἔλεγον Οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ προφήτης
verses.transliteration: oun akousantes toutōn tōn logōn Ek tou ochlou elegon Houtos estin alēthōs ho prophētēs
verses.literal: - On hearing these - words [some] of the people said This is truly the Prophet

verses.original: Ἄλλοι ἔλεγον Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός δὲ Οἱ ἔλεγον Μὴ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς ἔρχεται ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: Alloi elegon Houtos estin ho Christos de Hoi elegon Mē gar ho Christos erchetai ek tēs Galilaias
verses.literal: Others declared This is the Christ But still others asked vvv [How can] the Christ come from - Galilee

verses.original: οὐχ ἡ γραφὴ εἶπεν ὅτι ὁ Χριστός ἔρχεται ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματος Δαυὶδ καὶ ἀπὸ Βηθλεὲμ τῆς κώμης ὅπου Δαυὶδ ἦν
verses.transliteration: ouch hē graphē eipen hoti ho Christos erchetai ek tou spermatos Dauid kai apo Bēthleem tēs kōmēs hopou Dauid ēn
verses.literal: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem the village where David lived

verses.original: οὖν ἐγένετο Σχίσμα ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ δι’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun egeneto Schisma en tō ochlō di’ auton
verses.literal: So there was division in the crowd because of [Jesus]

verses.original: δὲ τινὲς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἤθελον πιάσαι αὐτόν ἀλλ’ οὐδεὶς ἐπέβαλεν τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: de tines ex autōn ēthelon piasai auton all’ oudeis epebalen tas cheiras ep’ auton
verses.literal: - Some of them wanted to seize Him but no one laid - a hand on Him

verses.original: οὖν οἱ ὑπηρέται Ἦλθον πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ Φαρισαίους καὶ ἐκεῖνοι εἶπον αὐτοῖς Διὰ τί οὐκ ἠγάγετε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun hoi hypēretai Ēlthon pros tous archiereis kai Pharisaious kai ekeinoi eipon autois Dia ti ouk ēgagete auton
verses.literal: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees - [who] asked them Why . . . vvv didn’t you bring Him {in}

verses.original: Οὐδέποτε ἄνθρωπος ἐλάλησεν οὕτως ὡς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος λαλεῖ οἱ ὑπηρέται Ἀπεκρίθησαν
verses.transliteration: Oudepote anthrōpos elalēsen houtōs hōs houtos ho anthrōpos lalei hoi hypēretai Apekrithēsan
verses.literal: Never {has} anyone spoken - like this - man - the officers answered

verses.original: ὑμεῖς Μὴ καὶ πεπλάνησθε οὖν Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: hymeis Mē kai peplanēsthe oun Apekrithēsan hoi Pharisaioi autois
verses.literal: {Have} you vvv also been deceived - replied the Pharisees -

verses.original: μή τις ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων ἢ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων ἐπίστευσεν εἰς αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: mē tis ek tōn archontōn ē ek tōn Pharisaiōn episteusen eis auton
verses.literal: {Have} any of the rulers or - - Pharisees believed in Him

verses.original: ἀλλὰ οὗτος ὁ ὄχλος ὁ μὴ γινώσκων τὸν νόμον εἰσιν ἐπάρατοί
verses.transliteration: alla houtos ho ochlos ho mē ginōskōn ton nomon eisin eparatoi
verses.literal: But this - crowd that vvv does not know the law they are under a curse

verses.original: Νικόδημος ὁ ἐλθὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν τὸ πρότερον ὢν εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν Λέγει πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Nikodēmos ho elthōn pros auton to proteron ōn heis ex autōn Legei pros autous
verses.literal: Nicodemus who had gone to [Jesus] - earlier [and who himself] was one of them asked - -

verses.original: ἡμῶν ὁ νόμος Μὴ κρίνει τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐὰν μὴ πρῶτον ἀκούσῃ παρ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ γνῷ τί ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: hēmōn ho nomos Mē krinei ton anthrōpon ean mē prōton akousē par’ autou kai gnō ti poiei
verses.literal: {Does} our - law vvv convict - a man vvv without first hearing from him - to determine what he has done

verses.original: εἶ Μὴ σὺ καὶ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ ἐραύνησον καὶ ἴδε ὅτι οὐκ προφήτης ἐγείρεται ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας
verses.transliteration: ei Mē sy kai ek tēs Galilaias Apekrithēsan kai eipan autō eraunēson kai ide hoti ouk prophētēs egeiretai ek tēs Galilaias
verses.literal: Aren’t . . . you also from - Galilee they replied . . . . . . . . . Look into it and you will see that no prophet comes out of - Galilee

verses.original: Καὶ ἕκαστος ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὸν αὐτοῦ οἶκον
verses.transliteration: Kai hekastos eporeuthēsan eis ton autou oikon
verses.literal: Then each went to - his own home
